messages:
jess: Quick check — midweek sync on kernel hotpath, KV eviction PRs, and continuous batching flakiness. Owners/blockers? Trying to get a canary this week.

rajesh: KV eviction PR #4382 now out for review. Addressed comments from olga, but we need SRE to greenlight raising the mem threshold. @sre-oncall can you take a look?

sre-oncall: I'll run the canary script against staging tonight and post perf+mem numbers. ETA ~22:00 PT.

matt: Kernel hotpath patch (hotpath-fix branch) cuts attention stall tail locally ~6%. Still need to run cross-region perf job before landing. Pushed a small refactor; CR link: https://git/repo/pull/4510. Quick note: use `git checkout hotpath-fix && bazel test //runtime/...` to repro.

olga: Continuous batching tests are failing under burst loads — seeing an NPE in the scheduler. Pushed a debug run and logs: `gs://redwood-test/logs/cont-batch-2024-07-18`. @matt can you sanity-check the scheduler change I pushed?

matt: On it. Suspect a race in queue drain. Can you capture a thread dump? Example repro command I ran: `./bin/run_test --concurrency=400 --seed=42`. Also throwing a tentative patch:```diff
-   void drain() {
-       // old
-   }
+   synchronized void drain() {
+       // avoid concurrent drains
+   }
```

jess: For clarity on ownership: Kernel => matt; KV eviction/metrics => rajesh; Continuous batching => olga. Cross-team deps: perf job (infra/perf), SRE mem config, and model-serving prefix-cache change. Can we aim for sign-off by Thu EOD? :calendar:

rajesh: I'll merge KV PR once SRE gives thumbs. Also FYI model-serving needs the new LRU hook in prefix cache — filed a heads-up issue for them. cc: @olga in case batching needs to consume the hook.

runtime-bot: Canary build queued: build-4412 (kernel+kv+batching), will post status to #eng-releases when complete.

sre-oncall: Canary results posted: p50 latency +3ms, p95 ~no change, memory down ~2% on staging. No obvious regressions in error rates. Approving mem threshold bump for canary.

olga: Thanks — I'll re-run the continuous-batching tests on the canary artifact and post a summary. If green, I'll file a small follow-up PR to harden the scheduler guard (to address the NPE).

jess: Solid. Rollout plan: run canary Tue night, evaluate Wed morning, full rollforward Thu morning if no blockers. Rollback plan: fallback to previous model variant + throttle batching if we see regression. Add `rollout.fallback = "model-v1"` in the canary config.

matt: I'll coordinate the perf job and add the sanity tests to the CI matrix.

jess: Thanks everyone — ping me if you hit anything blocking. :thumbsup:
